segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Ron,

Thanks for the time today. Recap of the calibration management rollout:

- 42 named users
- 3 facilities: Dayton, Fort Wayne, and Erie
- asset import for about 8,600 gauges and torque tools
- target go-live: November 18
- initial term: 24 months

I attached the order form and the implementation outline. Annual subscription is $34,200 and implementation is $6,500 one-time.

Maya

segments.speaker: Ron Ellis, Quality Systems Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

This is close. Two items before I send it to purchasing:

1. We only need 38 users at launch, not 42. The other four inspectors are seasonal.
2. Finance wants the implementation fee on the first invoice, but subscription split quarterly.

Can you revise for that?

Ron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Ron,

Yes. I updated the seat count to 38 and adjusted invoicing to show $6,500 implementation on invoice 1, with the subscription billed quarterly.

New annual subscription is $31,900. The 24-month term and November 18 go-live are unchanged.

Maya

segments.speaker: Ron Ellis, Quality Systems Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

Thanks. Purchasing is asking whether we can get this to $30,000 even. They are comparing it against what we paid for the old calibration database plus our outside cert uploads.

If not, I understand, but I need a yes/no before noon tomorrow.

Ron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Account Executive
segments.text:
Ron,

Per our messages, I can do $30,000 annual if you can return signature by Friday, 10/11. I’ll clean up the deal desk paperwork after so the order form matches. Implementation stays at $6,500 and quarterly billing is fine.

Maya

segments.speaker: Ron Ellis, Quality Systems Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

Understood. Please send the clean order form at $30,000 annual and $6,500 implementation. I’ll route it to Carrie in purchasing today.

One more thing: can you add that historical certs from 2021 forward are included in the import? That was in the implementation outline but not the order form.

Ron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Ron,

Attached is the updated order form. I added the 2021-forward certificate import language under Professional Services and kept the payment schedule as discussed.

Please have Carrie send the signed copy to me and billing@ourcompany.example once approved.

Maya

segments.speaker: Ron Ellis, Quality Systems Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

Carrie signed and sent it over a few minutes ago. PO 46872 is included on the form.

Please confirm the project kickoff for Tuesday, October 22 at 10:00 Eastern. We will have me, our metrology lead, and someone from IT on the call.

Ron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Account Executive
segments.text:
Ron,

Confirmed received. Kickoff is set for Tuesday, October 22 at 10:00 Eastern.

Next steps before then:

- we’ll send the asset import template by tomorrow
- your team can export the current gauge list and vendor cert files
- our implementation lead will review login groups for the 38 users

Thanks,
Maya
